metadata.phase: Phase 3: Monosemanticity Scoring (50/50 Discovery vs. Held-Out Split)

evaluation_protocol.discovery_split: Pairs 0-29 per category (N=30 pairs per category) used solely for neuron index selection
evaluation_protocol.held_out_test_split: Pairs 30-59 per category (N=30 pairs per category) containing structural near-misses and non-construct keyword controls (identifiers, string literals, comments)
evaluation_protocol.corpus_validation: Programmatic near-miss contrastive pairs (100% ast.parse() verified)
